title: Doubao Work Task Function Update: Control Your Computer Remotely from Your Phone, Breaking Device Barriers for Cross-Device Work
excerpt: Recently, ByteDance's smart assistant Doubao announced a major update to its "Work Tasks" mode - the official launch of the mobile phone remote control computer
content_html:
Recently, ByteDance's smart assistant Doubao announced a major update to its "Work Tasks" mode - the official launch of the mobile phone remote control computer function. Users just need to complete a simple authorization on the Doubao app on their mobile phone, and they can take over the computer logged in with the same account at any time, handle desktop tasks, breaking the device restrictions in the office scenario, and providing a more flexible solution for mobile work.

According to the official introduction, this feature supports retrieving file context in the local computer environment, efficiently handling documents, images, code, tables, and other types of materials, and completing complex computer operations. It has been verified for practicality in multiple high-frequency office scenarios: for example, if a user leaves home and finds that a file on the computer has not been sent, they can remotely search for local files on their phone, complete format conversions such as Pages to PDF, and send them back to the phone; when temporarily receiving modification suggestions but the computer is not nearby, they can remotely instruct the computer to generate summaries and charts and synchronize them to the phone; it also supports linking multiple computers with a single phone, enabling cross-device collaboration, and sending files from different computers to the phone in a unified way.

The operation threshold has also been significantly reduced: users just need to update Doubao to the latest version, log in with the same account as the computer, select the "Work Tasks" mode, click "Cloud Computer" to choose the operating environment, receive an SMS verification code to complete the authorization binding, and then quickly connect to the device and start using it.

Industry analysts believe that this feature accurately addresses the pain point of professionals who need to urgently handle work without having their computer nearby, further implementing the cross-terminal collaboration capabilities of smart assistants, and is expected to become the new standard in mobile office scenarios.

content_html_zh:
近日，字节跳动智能助手豆宝宣布其“工作任务”模式重大更新——正式上线手机远程控制电脑功能。 用户只需在手机上的豆宝App上完成简单的授权，就可以随时接管同一账号登录的电脑，处理桌面任务，打破办公场景的设备限制，为移动工作提供更灵活的解决方案。

据官方介绍，该功能支持检索本地计算机环境中的文件上下文，高效处理文档、图像、代码、表格等类型素材，完成复杂的计算机操作。 已在多个高频办公场景中验证了实用性：例如，用户出门在外，发现电脑上的文件尚未发送，可以远程搜索手机上的本地文件，完成Pages转PDF等格式转换，并发回手机；当临时收到修改建议但电脑不在附近时，可以远程指令电脑生成摘要和图表并同步到手机；它还支持一台手机连接多台电脑，实现跨设备协作，将不同电脑的文件统一发送到手机。

操作门槛也大幅降低：用户只需将豆宝更新至最新版本，使用与电脑相同的账号登录，选择“工作任务”模式，点击“云电脑”选择操作环境，接收短信验证码即可完成授权绑定，然后快速连接设备即可开始使用。

业内分析认为，该功能精准解决了职场人士需要在电脑不在身边紧急处理工作的痛点，进一步实现了智能助手的跨终端协作能力，有望成为移动办公场景的新标准。
